title: Coinbase CEO Predicts Bitcoin's Downturn Is Over
description:
Insight with Haslinda Amin, a daily news program featuring in-depth, high-profile interviews and analysis to give viewers the complete picture on the stories that matter. The show features prominent leaders spanning the worlds of business, finance, politics and culture.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - Insight with Haslinda Amin Begins
00:02:21 - President Trump signals confidence the US will win war
00:03:42 - Brent trades over $100 rattling stocks 
00:05:55 - Manulife Investment Management's Yuting Shao on oil prices
00:12:41 - Jio Financial Services targets major increase in customer base
00:13:11 - Jio Financial Services CEO Hitesh Sethia on plans to reach 100 million customers
00:18:01 - Jio on AI
00:23:06 - Bitcoin under pressure from AI boom and cyber attacks
00:23:54 - Coinbase Co-Founder, Chairman & CEO Brian Armstrong on crypto regulation
00:26:17 - Brian Armstrong on bitcoin’s cycle
00:33:36 - India GIFT City IFSC banks disburse $52.8B via RBI swap (11D) IFSCA Executive Director Dipesh Shah on GIFT City’s growt
00:37:28 - IFSCA Executive Director Dipesh Shah on GIFT City’s growth
00:41:34 -  Dipesh Shah on regulatory reforms and future dual-listing opportunities
